bias.en: Pullback · lost the 10 and 30-day, SAR at $510
bias.zh: 回调 · 跌破 10 日和 30 日均线，抛物线 SAR 在 $510

read.en: Microsoft fell 2.3% on Nov 11 to $521.13, trading $518.45–534.76. It is below the 5-day ($533.2), 10-day ($530.2) and 30-day ($530.0) and above the 100-day ($477.0) and 200-day ($440.8); all five are rising. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 10, above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 4 ($510.17), and RSI is 47.7.
read.zh: 微软 11月11日下跌 2.3%，收于 $521.13，盘中区间 $518.45–534.76。股价位于 5 日（$533.2）、10 日（$530.2）和 30 日均线（$530.0）下方，100 日（$477.0）和 200 日均线（$440.8）上方；五条均线均在上行。MACD 自 11月10日起位于信号线下方，在零轴上方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看多（$510.17），RSI 为 47.7。

read.en: The close lost the 10 and 30-day and the $524.5–526.4 Nov 6 and Nov 10 lows, now resistance. Resistance is $524.5–530.2, then $533.2–534.8 (5-day, Nov 11 high) and $541.3–544.2 (Oct 29 high, Nov 4 low, Nov 10 high). Support is $518.5–521 (Nov 11 low, Nov 3 close), then $505–510.2 (Nov 2 and 3 lows, SAR) and $486 (Sep 10 low). A close above $530.2 would target $533–535; below $510.2, the SAR flips and $486 opens.
